product_launches.description: Ramen launched Aura 15.0, a major update of its multi-agent AI assistant for Unreal Engine and Unity, adding Sandbox Mode, Aura Skills, verification and material agents, command-line execution, and introducing new Indie, Pro, and Ultimate pricing tiers with unlimited Auto Mode usage.

press_references.value: Next Evolution of Best-In-Class Multi-agent AI Assistant for Unreal Engine Releases with Aura 12.0 Beta

product_launches.description: Ramen released Aura 12.0 beta, the latest version of its multi-agent AI assistant for Unreal Engine, adding Telos 2.0, new animation and rigging tools, and the Dragon Agent for autonomous workflows.

press_references.value: Aura AI Assistant for Unreal Engine Launches: VR Studio Ships Game in Half the Time with New Agent Capabilities

product_launches.description: Ramen VR launched Aura, an AI assistant and agent for Epic's Unreal Engine that includes new Editor-Use and Coding Agents to accelerate game development workflows.

overview_description.description: Ramen VR is a game development platform. It specializes in using XR and AI to build products that empower creators of online games and virtual worlds. It blends tech and AI to create tools that allow users to shape their own realities and discover new ways to interact with the digital and physical worlds.
